rules.content:
// KQL for IRSF Traffic Spike Detection
// Detects abnormal call volume to premium-rate international numbers
let premium_rate_calls = CallDetailRecords
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where CallDirection == "outbound"
| where DestinationType == "international"
| join kind=inner (PremiumRateRanges) on $left.DestinationPrefix == $right.NumberPrefix
| summarize CallCount = count(),
            TotalDurationSec = sum(CallDurationSeconds),
            UniqueCallers = dcount(CallingNumber),
            UniqueDestinations = dcount(CalledNumber),
            AvgDuration = avg(CallDurationSeconds)
  by SourceSystem, TrunkGroup, RiskCountry, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h);
let baselines = CallDetailRecords
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) and TimeGenerated < ago(1h)
| where CallDirection == "outbound"
| where DestinationType == "international"
| join kind=inner (PremiumRateRanges) on $left.DestinationPrefix == $right.NumberPrefix
| summarize HourlyCount = count()
  by SourceSystem, TrunkGroup, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| summarize BaselineCount = avg(HourlyCount), StdevCount = stdev(HourlyCount)
  by SourceSystem, TrunkGroup;
premium_rate_calls
| join kind=inner baselines on SourceSystem, TrunkGroup
| extend ZScore = iff(StdevCount > 0, (CallCount - BaselineCount) / StdevCount, 0.0)
| where ZScore > 3
| project SourceSystem, TrunkGroup, RiskCountry, TimeGenerated,
          CallCount, TotalDurationSec, UniqueCallers, UniqueDestinations,
          AvgDuration, BaselineCount, ZScore
| order by ZScore desc
rules.title: DL-0182: IRSF Traffic Spike Detection — Abnormal Call Volume to Premium-Rate International Numbers (KQL)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Wangiri Callback Velocity — DL-0183")`
`comment("Detects high volume of short-duration outbound international calls")`
index=flame_telecom sourcetype=flame:cdr
  call_direction="outbound"
  call_type="international"
  call_duration_seconds < 5
| lookup premium_rate_ranges number_prefix OUTPUTNEW is_premium_rate, risk_country
| where is_premium_rate="true"
| bin _time span=24h
| stats count as short_call_count,
        dc(called_number) as unique_destinations,
        dc(destination_country) as unique_countries,
        values(called_number) as called_numbers,
        values(destination_country) as countries,
        avg(call_duration_seconds) as avg_duration,
        earliest(_time) as first_call,
        latest(_time) as last_call
  by calling_number, source_system, _time
| where short_call_count >= 10 AND unique_destinations >= 3
| eval risk_score = case(
    short_call_count >= 50 AND unique_destinations >= 10, "critical",
    short_call_count >= 25 AND unique_destinations >= 5, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table calling_number, source_system, short_call_count, unique_destinations,
        unique_countries, called_numbers, countries, avg_duration,
        first_call, last_call, risk_score
| sort - short_call_count
rules.title: DL-0183: Wangiri Callback Velocity — High Volume of Short-Duration Outbound International Calls From Single Source (SPLUNK)
